# criblio_cribl_lake_datasets (Data Source)

Returns all matching objects in `items`, following API pagination automatically. Scope the request using the required attributes below. An empty collection returns an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_cribl_lake_datasets" "example" {
  lake_id = "default"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `lake_id` (String) The <code>id</code> of the Lake that contains the Lake Datasets to list.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `accelerated_fields` (List of String) Accelerated fields for the Dataset.
- `bucket_name` (String) Name of the legacy Cribl Lake bucket that backs the Dataset.
- `description` (String) Brief description of the Dataset.
- `format` (String)
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the Dataset.
- `lake_id` (String) The <code>id</code> of the Lake to create the Lake Datasets in.
- `retention_period_in_days` (Integer) Dataset retention period, in days.
- `search_config` (Attributes) Search configuration for the Dataset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--search_config))
- `storage_class` (String)
- `storage_location_id` (String) Identifier for the Storage Location that backs the Dataset.

<a id="nestedatt--items--search_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.search_config`

Read-Only:

- `datatypes` (List of String) Datatype identifiers assigned to the Dataset.
- `metadata` (Attributes) Key-value metadata for the Dataset search configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--search_config--metadata))

<a id="nestedatt--items--search_config--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.search_config.metadata`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `enable_acceleration` (Boolean) Whether acceleration is enabled for this dataset.
- `modified` (String) Last modification timestamp.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags associated with the dataset.
